home.title: SouMoster — Android Game Developer
home.description: SouMoster is an independent Android game developer. Download Road Hopper, Bank Hopper and Time Hopper free on Google Play. Arena Legends, our first action game, is in Google Play Closed Testing. Space Hopper and Nitro Racer, our first racing game, are in development. Watch trailers on YouTube @SouMosterGames.

apps.title: Apps
apps.description: Browse SouMoster Android games. Download Road Hopper, Bank Hopper and Time Hopper, join the Arena Legends closed test on Google Play, see Nitro Racer, and follow trailers on YouTube.

about.title: About
about.description: Learn about SouMoster — independent Android games including Road Hopper, Bank Hopper and Time Hopper (live), Arena Legends (Google Play Closed Testing), Space Hopper and Nitro Racer (in development). YouTube @SouMosterGames.

beta.title: Join Closed Beta
beta.description: Arena Legends v0.1.11 is in Google Play Closed Testing, and Time Hopper is now live on Google Play. Sign up for the SouMoster tester track, install from Play, and watch trailers on YouTube @SouMosterGames.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Get in touch with SouMoster. Email, Google Play, YouTube @SouMosterGames, and socials.

support.title: Support
support.description: Get help with SouMoster games. Report bugs, request features, or browse our FAQ.

press.description: SouMoster press kit: studio fact sheet, game fact sheets, logos, icons, banners, screenshots, and trailer links for Road Hopper, Bank Hopper, Time Hopper, Arena Legends, Space Hopper, and Nitro Racer.
